info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Meetings Meetings Participants-v5-spec
info.description: The Meetings Participants Retrieval API allows users to access detailed information about participants in scheduled meetings. Through this endpoint, developers can retrieve lists of participants associated with specific meetings, enabling better management and analysis of attendee involvement. This functionality is particularly beneficial for applications focused on meeting coordination, event planning, or team collaboration. Typical consumers include project managers, event organizers, and CRM systems looking to enhance group engagement through informed participation tracking.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the list of participants associated with a specific meeting. It provides detailed information about each participant, including their roles and statuses within the meeting.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving participants from meetings. This structure allows the client to specify the necessary parameters to fetch relevant participant information.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of meeting participants.

ListMeetingsMeetingsParticipantsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for retrieving participants in a meeting. It is a string value that can be used for various purposes related to meeting participant data.
